spans.s:
IDEA:
I Conception: बुद्धिः,
under the i. of a
tiger:
व्याघ्रबुद्ध्पा।
To have an i.:
सम्भावयति (c. of
भू).
II Opinion: q.v.: मतम्।
III A
thought: मावः, -ना।
IV Platonic: perh.
कल्पना।

IDEAL:
I Mental: q.v.: मानसिकः (की, कं).
II Conceived in the mind, visionary:
काल्पनिकः (की, कं).
III Perfect, best: expr.
by परमः (मा, मं),
i. form of virtue:
परमधर्म-
लक्षणम्।
IDEALLY: मनसा (= in mind): v. Ideal.

IDENTICAL:
he is the i. person:
स एवैषः: v.
Same.

IDENTIFY:
I To make to be the the same:
मिथुनीकरोति (= to couple), S.; and sim.
verbs.
II To prove to be same: expr. by
circumlo.,
to i. stolen property:
लोप्त्रमेवैतदिति
 प्रदर्शयति (c. of दृश्,)
or
प्रतिपादयति (c. of पद्):
v. Also to recognize.

IDENTITY:
I Sameness: q.v.: ऐक्यम्।
II
The condition of being identical: expr. by
adj.,
to prove the i. of an offender:
सोऽपराध्येव एष
